## The Plan For Contributing Changes to BusMgmtBenchmarks Repo

1. Create a codespace on `main` of BusMgmtBenchmarks
2. Start Codex in the terminal with `codex.sh`
3. Sign in with a device code
4. Choose the `gpt-6-sol` model with `/model`
5. Ask Codex to start the dev server, then open the app
6. Ask Codex to make the **Export to Excel** button orange
7. Ask Codex to commit and push the change

## What You Need

- A GitHub account
- The repository: [https://github.com/calvinw/BusMgmtBenchmarks](https://github.com/calvinw/BusMgmtBenchmarks)
- To push your changes, you must be a **collaborator** on that repository
- A ChatGPT account to sign in to Codex
- The live app, to compare before and after: [Company vs Company](https://calvinw.github.io/BusMgmtBenchmarks/company_to_company.html)

## The Dev Server

- The dev server runs your copy of the site inside the codespace
- It watches the files: when a file changes, the page reloads by itself
- Only you can see it - the public site does not change until you push
- If it stops, ask Codex to run `start_servers.sh` again

## You Must Be a Collaborator

- Anyone can make a codespace and change files in it
- Only **collaborators** can push those changes to [calvinw/BusMgmtBenchmarks](https://github.com/calvinw/BusMgmtBenchmarks)
- If you are not a collaborator, the push fails with a permission error
- Ask Calvin to add you under **Settings** > **Collaborators**
- Accept the invitation from your email or GitHub notifications, then ask Codex to push again

## Check the Live Site

- The push starts the deploy in the repository's **Actions** tab
- Wait for the green check mark
- Reload [Company vs Company](https://calvinw.github.io/BusMgmtBenchmarks/company_to_company.html)
- The **Export to Excel** button is now orange

## Summary

- A codespace gives you VS Code and a terminal in the browser
- `codex.sh` starts Codex; sign in and pick a model
- Codex starts the dev server so you see changes live
- Describe the change, then ask Codex to commit and push
